// diagnostic

E2904

Performance budgets `{a}` and `{b}` overlap

What

Performance budgets `{a}` and `{b}` overlap

Why

Both declarations cover the same effective metric, scope, provider, target, profile, and applicability key.

Fix

remove one declaration or make their applicability disjoint.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E2904: tests/ui/perf_budget_e2904_overlap.stderr.

Error [E2904]: performance budgets binary and shipping overlap
  --> tests/ui/perf_budget_e2904_overlap.jet:4:9
    |
  4 |         Budget{ name: "shipping", metric: .BinarySize, limit: .AtMost(3MiB) },
    |         ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: their scope, metric, provider, and intersecting applicability form the same effective key
 Fix: remove one budget or make their target/profile applicability disjoint
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E2904

Error [E0101]: this program has no `run` function
 Why: running a program starts at `fn run`, and the entry file doesn't define one
 Fix: add `fn run() { ... }` to the entry file
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0101
